policy.purpose: Public distributor hints by municipality or zone, only from verified public sources.
policy.privacy: No CUPS, no personal data, no exact user addresses, no private coordinates.
policy.infrastructure: No substations, no power lines, no cable routes, no critical infrastructure inventory.
policy.fallback: If a distributor is not verified for a zone, the app must show a generic consultation message.
